Subscribe · Support · Listen

Three ways to
stay close to the show.

Listen in whatever app you already use. Get the weekly note in your inbox. And — if the show has come to mean something to you — consider becoming a supporter. The show stays independent because of listeners like you. That's the whole funding model.

Where to listen

All the apps.

The feed is open and the show is everywhere a public RSS feed can reach. There's no Spotify-exclusive episode, no Apple-only bonus content, no platform that gets the new episode first. Tuesday at 6am Pacific, everywhere at once.

Apple Podcasts

The single biggest source of new listeners for the show. If you find the show useful, a rating and a written review on Apple does an embarrassingly large amount of work for an independent podcast.

Open in Apple →

Spotify

Yes, the show is on Spotify. No, they don't pay me to be there. Spotify follows are the second most useful single action you can take if you want to see the show grow.

Open in Spotify →

Overcast

My personal app of choice and the one I use to listen to every other podcast I love. Marco Arment's Smart Speed is genuinely magical and Voice Boost is excellent for spoken word audio.

Open in Overcast →

Pocket Casts

Cross-platform, beautifully designed, with the best web player in the space. The Pocket Casts community has been remarkably generous to the show — thank you, all of you.

Open in Pocket Casts →

Castro

A small, opinionated iOS-only client with a triage-based listening model. If you queue more than you can ever finish, Castro is built for you. The show works perfectly there.

Open in Castro →

YouTube

An audio-only YouTube channel with each new episode as a single static image. If you've got a smart TV and like to listen while you cook, this is the easiest way. No video, by design — sorry.

Open YouTube →
The actual feed

RSS · the open way.

If your podcast player accepts a feed URL (and any decent one does), you can subscribe directly. No middleman, no tracking pixels, no platform that can decide to delist us. This is the same feed I started with on March 5, 2024.

https://feeds.transistor.fm/slow-burn-stories
The Tuesday email

A weekly note from Cassia.

Each Tuesday morning, a short email goes out with the new episode, a few sentences on what I cut and why, and one or two unrelated things I read or watched or made that I can't stop thinking about. No tracking pixels. One-click unsubscribe.

9,400+ readers · sent Tuesday at 8am PT · archive at /letters

Support the show

Listener-funded.
Listener-shaped.

The show takes no advertising. No host-read ads, no programmatic, no pre-roll. It's not a moral position — it's a quality-of-life one. The ads I'd have to read to fund the show at this scale would change the show I want to make. So instead, three small tiers, all monthly, all cancel-anytime. About 1,900 listeners currently support the show. That's the entire budget.

Free · Always

The Listener

$0/month
  • Every episode, free, forever
  • The Tuesday newsletter
  • The full transcript archive
  • The pleasant feeling of having gotten away with something
Just listen →
Most chosen · 71% of supporters

The Regular

$5/month
  • Everything in The Listener
  • Ad-free, longer "extended cut" of every episode (about 15 min longer on average)
  • Access to the monthly bonus episode — usually a single longer-than-usual conversation
  • The private Discord for supporters & the once-a-month listener call
  • The good feeling of paying for something independent you love
Become a Regular
For the deeply invested

The Patron

$15/month
  • Everything in The Regular
  • Your name in the credits of one episode per year (your choice)
  • An annual hand-stitched, hand-numbered show notes booklet, printed in Oakland
  • Early invitation to the once-a-year live recording in the Bay Area
  • A handwritten thank-you note from me, eventually, when I get to it
Become a Patron

All tiers can be paused or canceled with one click. If $5 a month is genuinely a stretch — student, fixed income, between jobs — email me at hello@slowburnstories.fm and I'll comp you whatever tier you'd like for as long as you need. This is a real offer. It happens often. Nobody asks why.
